name: Cobbleclaw
lore: A small masonry crab from Silverfall Reach, carrying a shell of polished river stones. It catches trouble in its claws and returns it with interest.

primary.name: Pincer Ledger
primary.description: Two quick, visible claw snaps for 14 damage each. Both hit only their own short forward fans.

secondary.name: Shell Receipt
secondary.description: Brace for 3.5 seconds with 50% damage reduction. Catch up to four hostile projectiles touching the shell; bank them for 12 seconds.

special.name: Crosswalk Crush
special.description: Scuttle along the shown route, dealing 36 damage once per foe, pushing and slowing. At the end, spend banked shots on 12-damage stone shards. Walls stop the rush.

passive: Shell Ledger: each banked projectile grants 3% damage reduction, up to 12%. Spend the bank or let it expire to lose this protection.

technique.name: Heavy Accounts

attack.name: Heavy Accounts
attack.description: Two slower heavy snaps, 22 damage each, with longer reach.

technique.description: Trade quick claw rhythm for heavier, slower snaps.

final_technique.name: Pebble Nursery

attack.name: Pebble Nursery
attack.description: Build a four-second stationary pebble refuge. Allies receive 20% damage reduction and 4 HP/sec, plus 1 HP/sec per banked shot consumed.

final_technique.description: Trade projectile catching for a small allied refuge.
